name: Francis De Leon Sanchez
office: City of Bell Gardens, Member of the City Council

items.text: Francis De Leon Sanchez is a member of the Bell Gardens City Council. She is an administrator in the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District and previously taught in the Montebello Unified School District. She chairs the California Cities for Self-Reliance Joint Powers Authority. She holds a doctorate in educational leadership from Cal Poly Pomona.

sentences.text: Francis De Leon Sanchez is a member of the Bell Gardens City Council.
She is an administrator in the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District and previously taught in the Montebello Unified School District.
She chairs the California Cities for Self-Reliance Joint Powers Authority.
She holds a doctorate in educational leadership from Cal Poly Pomona.

items.text: She supported Measure BG, a quarter-cent sales tax for public safety, parks, and streets, and opposed state cardroom rules she said threatened city revenue. Her campaign priorities are public safety, investing in neighborhoods, and infrastructure. She launched a city services app and a car show that raises scholarship funds. When she was mayor in 2023, a recall effort against her over a cannabis dispensary ordinance failed after the notices were found insufficient.
